problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a cargo drone. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 17 m³, revenue $99
* Package 2: volume 48 m³, revenue $11
* Package 3: volume 42 m³, revenue $260
* Package 4: volume 17 m³, revenue $30
* Package 5: volume 5 m³, revenue $26
* Package 6: volume 23 m³, revenue $296
* Package 7: volume 31 m³, revenue $233
* Package 8: volume 37 m³, revenue $259
* Package 9: volume 50 m³, revenue $73
* Package 10: volume 13 m³, revenue $35
* Package 11: volume 24 m³, revenue $209
* Package 12: volume 17 m³, revenue $186
* Package 13: volume 34 m³, revenue $183
* Package 14: volume 9 m³, revenue $178
* Package 15: volume 10 m³, revenue $72
* Package 16: volume 47 m³, revenue $192
* Package 17: volume 6 m³, revenue $148
* Package 18: volume 23 m³, revenue $214
* Package 19: volume 7 m³, revenue $170
* Package 20: volume 38 m³, revenue $82
* Package 21: volume 25 m³, revenue $268
* Package 22: volume 19 m³, revenue $139
* Package 23: volume 23 m³, revenue $93
* Package 24: volume 37 m³, revenue $38
* Package 25: volume 8 m³, revenue $109
* Package 26: volume 31 m³, revenue $57
* Package 27: volume 21 m³, revenue $123
* Package 28: volume 17 m³, revenue $236
* Package 29: volume 11 m³, revenue $229
* Package 30: volume 41 m³, revenue $114
The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 511 m³. Select the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully loaded or not loaded.
